notes.title: Five-Finger Gunslinger is Available to Download Now!
notes.content:
Five-Finger Gunslinger is now available on the Steam Store for $1.99!

We have finally successfully gone through the Steam approval process and our game is out TODAY!

We have done it, A fully published game. Our small student team of seven people is so proud to finally release this game out to the world. Six months of work over the semester and the summer, thank you to everyone who supported us! If you enjoy playing please let us know, share any videos of gameplay, tell us what you think, tell us what you want, this game is made to be sharable and quick to digest, so we're gonna let it roam free. Have fun, Everyone!

Due to our team returning to classes, content updates should not be expected past release. We hope to fix bugs and any major issues that we did not catch, but we are confident in the state of the game stability wise! Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Five-Finger Gunslinger is Almost Here!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Our original release date goal was for August 28th, or...uhh...yesterday. Our game had a hiccup in the steam review process and cannot be released until it is reevaluated. [b]The game will be released as soon as it is approved by Steam.[/b] This should not take more than a few days.

Thank you to everyone who has shown support through the development of this game. This game started as our Production class project but turned into so much more. A full game, with everything that would entail, was a new experience for every person on this team. We are sorry for this short delay.

We are really proud of the product we have achieved. Six months of work by a seven-person team, finally out to be judged by the world. We hope that you enjoy this little game in these weird times, and we hope that you can call up your friends and play a quick game of Five-Finger Gunslinger to have a few good laughs. 


Thank you for your interest! We hope you love Five-Finger Gunslinger as much as us.


As a side note, all the members of Team Rat Vibes are returning to classes in a few days. Except for game-breaking bugs or issues on release, do not expect any content updates to this game after release. Thank you for your understanding, and know that this is the first of many great games to come from everyone on this team.
